description: What is below a point, in one call: seismic zone, nearest active faults, lineaments and recorded earthquakes, rock type (GSI lithology) and landform, aquifer, a permeability class (GLHYMPS, global and coarse), nearby groundwater wells, soil at 0-5, 5-15 and 15-30 cm (ISRIC SoilGrids 2.0: clay, sand, silt, pH, organic carbon, bulk density, CEC, nitrogen, WRB soil group) and the nearest Soil Health Card sample, ground subsidence (cm/yr) in megacities, and tunnels, buried pipelines and cables, mines and caves nearby. Returns a one-line `summary` plus `sections`, each layer with its credit, licence (non-commercial ones flagged) and status (found, none_within_radius, or not_covered where the layer does not reach the point); layers that could not be read are listed in `unavailable`. Example: 'what is under this plot in Delhi?' -> lat: 28.525, lng: 77.085.

open_only.description: true leaves out the non-commercial layers (for commercial use); default false

name: ground_at
